info.title: runic-create
info.description: Guided creator for Runic applications. Run it with dnx Runic.Create.

commands.name: completion
commands.description: Generate bash, zsh, fish or PowerShell completions

options.name: --output
options.description: Create the project in this directory instead, as dotnet new

options.name: --frontend
options.description: Frontend framework.

options.name: --angular-build
options.description:
What builds an Angular frontend: cli (the Angular CLI) or vite
(Vite with the Analog Angular plugin).

options.name: --package-manager
options.description: JavaScript package manager.

options.name: --host
options.description:
Window host: desktop opens a native window, cswebui opens a
browser window.

options.name: --linux-gtk
options.description: GTK version of Runic Desktop on Linux: 3 or 4.

options.name: --desktop-server
options.description: Server Runic Desktop serves the page from: native or kestrel.

options.name: --view-models
options.description: MVVM library for the C# ViewModels.

options.name: --editor
options.description:
Editor files: none, or vscode for .vscode/ tasks and debug
configurations.

options.name: --tests
options.description: Add a TUnit test project for the Window.

options.name: --translations
options.description:
Translate the application with Runic Translations: one catalog in
English and German for the page and C#, and a language switch.

options.name: --nix
options.description:
Add a Nix flake that builds the application with the Runic SDK's
builder.

options.name: --packaging
options.description:
Add the packaging/ manifests that dotnet runic package fills, to
edit them: MSIX, macOS bundle, desktop entry, AppStream metadata
and Flatpak manifest.

options.name: --restore
options.description:
Restore the project's NuGet packages after creating it, for an
IDE that opens it next.

options.name: --force
options.description:
Create the project in a directory that is not empty, as dotnet
new --force does. Files the template writes are replaced.

options.name: --no-install
options.description:
Use the installed Runic.Application.Templates instead of
installing this version, for example offline.

options.name: --yes
options.description:
Use the default for every option you do not pass instead of
asking.

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Print the commands without running them.

options.name: --template-source
options.description: An additional NuGet source for the template package.

options.name: --application-id
options.description:
The reverse-DNS application ID, such as org.example.Notes: the
desktop entry and Flatpak ID on Linux, the bundle identifier on
macOS and the package name on Windows. Default: com.example. and
the project name's ASCII letters and digits, at most 50
characters, as an MSIX package name allows.

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help

options.name: --version
options.description: Show version

options.name: --format
options.description: Select output format
